title: Agent Permission Gateway - Grants and Manifests
description: A Grant authorizes an agent to perform one scope (resource:verb) under optional constraints, for a bounded lifetime, with a pointer back to the user text that created it. Missing constraint = unconstrained within that scope. Principals are case-insensitive; '@domain' matches any address at that domain. Constraint applicability per scope is enforced in code (see 'x-applies-to').

Scope.description: Tool -> scope mapping: email_search, email_read -> email:read | email_send -> email:send | calendar_list -> calendar:read | calendar_create_event -> calendar:write | payments_purchase -> payments:purchase

Window.description: calendar_list: requested range must sit inside the window. calendar_create_event: event start and end must sit inside the window.

senders.description: email_read: message.from must match. email_search: results are FILTERED to these senders (least privilege: the agent never sees the others).

recipients.description: Every address in to + cc must match.

attendees.description: Every attendee must match. Empty array = event may have no attendees.

type.description: task: dies when the current user turn ends. session: survives across turns in one conversation. standing: never expires.

source.description: user_message: minted from a manifest the user approved. user_approval: minted from an approved escalation (one-shot). policy_default: static grant from policies.yaml.

user_text_excerpt.description: Verbatim span of USER-AUTHORED text that justifies the grant. Never from tool output.

ProposedGrant.description: What the planner emits. The gateway assigns id, lifetime and provenance.

user_text_excerpt.description: PROVENANCE RULE: must be an exact substring of the user's message. Gateway drops the grant and logs provenance_violation otherwise.

GrantManifest.description: Planner output for one user turn. Shown to the user as a single approval prompt (if non-empty).

unresolved.description: Things the planner could not pin down from user text alone (e.g. 'merchant for Dad's gift unknown'). Logged for the write-up.

Decision.description: One audit-log line per tool call.

derived.description: Enriched fields used for matching, e.g. {from: ...} for email_read, {recipients: [...]} for email_send

reasons.description: Why each candidate grant did or didn't match, e.g. 'g_003: recipient dev.k@other.example not in [priya.shah@friends.example]'
